t: 法国的统治结束于海地. 海地成为继美国后北美第一个以黑人为主的共和国和第二个独立国家.
te: French rule ends in Haiti. Haiti becomes the first black-majority republic and second independent country in North Amer…
dz: 法国的统治结束于海地. 海地成为继美国后北美第一个以黑人为主的共和国和第二个独立国家.
de: French rule ends in Haiti. Haiti becomes the first black-majority republic and second independent country in North America after the United States.

t: 卡拉多尔杰领导了第一次塞尔维亚起义反抗奥斯曼帝国.
te: Karađorđe leads the First Serbian Uprising against the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 卡拉多尔杰领导了第一次塞尔维亚起义反抗奥斯曼帝国.
de: Karađorđe leads the First Serbian Uprising against the Ottoman Empire.

t: 史蒂芬·迪凯特率领一场突袭烧毁了海盗控制的费城号护卫舰。
te: Stephen Decatur leads a raid to burn the pirate-held frigate USS Philadelphia.
dz: 第一次巴巴里战争：史蒂芬·迪凯特率领一场突袭烧毁了海盗控制的费城号护卫舰。
de: First Barbary War: Stephen Decatur leads a raid to burn the pirate-held frigate USS Philadelphia.

t: 第一台自推式蒸汽机车在威尔士的彭-y-Darren铁厂出道.
te: The first self-propelling steam locomotive makes its outing at the Pen-y-Darren Ironworks in Wales.
dz: 第一台自推式蒸汽机车在威尔士的彭-y-Darren铁厂出道.
de: The first self-propelling steam locomotive makes its outing at the Pen-y-Darren Ironworks in Wales.

t: 爱尔兰罪犯 在新南威尔士殖民地反抗英国殖民当局.
te: Irish convicts rebel against British colonial authority in the Colony of New South Wales.
dz: Castle Hill Rebellion:爱尔兰罪犯 在新南威尔士殖民地反抗英国殖民当局.
de: Castle Hill Rebellion: Irish convicts rebel against British colonial authority in the Colony of New South Wales.

t: 纳波莱昂法典被采纳为法国民法.
te: Code Napoléon is adopted as French civil law.
dz: 纳波莱昂法典被采纳为法国民法.
de: Code Napoléon is adopted as French civil law.

t: 由的黎波里的优素福·卡拉曼利(Yusuf Karamanli)所派遣的部队从美国人手中夺回德纳…
te: Forces sent by Yusuf Karamanli of Tripoli to retake Derna from the Americans attack the city.
dz: 由的黎波里的优素福·卡拉曼利(Yusuf Karamanli)所派遣的部队从美国人手中夺回德纳来攻城.
de: Forces sent by Yusuf Karamanli of Tripoli to retake Derna from the Americans attack the city.

t: 威廉·克拉克和42人从杜波依斯营出发去密苏里州圣查尔斯与梅里韦瑟·刘易斯会合,这标志着刘易斯和…
te: William Clark and 42 men depart from Camp Dubois to join Meriwether Lewis at St Charles, Missouri, marking the beginnin…
dz: 威廉·克拉克和42人从杜波依斯营出发去密苏里州圣查尔斯与梅里韦瑟·刘易斯会合,这标志着刘易斯和克拉克远征队在密苏里河上的历史旅程的开始.
de: William Clark and 42 men depart from Camp Dubois to join Meriwether Lewis at St Charles, Missouri, marking the beginning of the Lewis and Clark Expedition's historic journey up the Missouri River.

t: 拿破仑·波拿巴被法国参议院宣布为法国皇帝。
te: Napoleon Bonaparte is proclaimed Emperor of the French by the French Senate.
dz: 拿破仑·波拿巴被法国参议院宣布为法国皇帝。
de: Napoleon Bonaparte is proclaimed Emperor of the French by the French Senate.

t: 刘易斯和克拉克远征军随着发现军团从密苏里州圣查尔斯出发而正式起事.
te: The Lewis and Clark Expedition officially begins as the Corps of Discovery departs from St. Charles, Missouri.
dz: 刘易斯和克拉克远征军随着发现军团从密苏里州圣查尔斯出发而正式起事.
de: The Lewis and Clark Expedition officially begins as the Corps of Discovery departs from St. Charles, Missouri.

t: 新罕布什尔州批准美国宪法第十二修正案,批准该文件.
te: New Hampshire approves the Twelfth Amendment to the United States Constitution, ratifying the document.
dz: 新罕布什尔州批准美国宪法第十二修正案,批准该文件.
de: New Hampshire approves the Twelfth Amendment to the United States Constitution, ratifying the document.

t: 美国副总统亚伦·伯尔(Aaron Burr)在一次决斗中伤重了前财政部长亚历山大·汉密尔顿.
te: A duel occurs in which the Vice President of the United States Aaron Burr mortally wounds former Secretary of the Treas…
dz: 美国副总统亚伦·伯尔(Aaron Burr)在一次决斗中伤重了前财政部长亚历山大·汉密尔顿.
de: A duel occurs in which the Vice President of the United States Aaron Burr mortally wounds former Secretary of the Treasury Alexander Hamilton.

t: 弗朗西斯二世出任奥地利第一任皇帝.
te: Francis II assumes the title of first Emperor of Austria.
dz: 弗朗西斯二世出任奥地利第一任皇帝.
de: Francis II assumes the title of first Emperor of Austria.

t: 3 朱诺(德语:Juno)是主带中最大的小行星之一,由德国天文学家卡尔·路德维希·哈定所发现.
te: 3 Juno, one of the largest asteroids in the Main Belt, is discovered by the German astronomer Karl Ludwig Harding.
dz: 3 朱诺(德语:Juno)是主带中最大的小行星之一,由德国天文学家卡尔·路德维希·哈定所发现.
de: 3 Juno, one of the largest asteroids in the Main Belt, is discovered by the German astronomer Karl Ludwig Harding.

t: 泰通苏号(拉科塔号的一个分舰队)要求从刘易斯号和克拉克号远征号上划出一艘船,作为允许远征队向上…
te: The Teton Sioux (a subdivision of the Lakota) demand one of the boats from the Lewis and Clark Expedition as a toll for…
dz: 泰通苏号(拉科塔号的一个分舰队)要求从刘易斯号和克拉克号远征号上划出一艘船,作为允许远征队向上游更远移动的收费.
de: The Teton Sioux (a subdivision of the Lakota) demand one of the boats from the Lewis and Clark Expedition as a toll for allowing the expedition to move further upriver.

t: 塔斯马尼亚州首府霍巴特成立.
te: Hobart, capital of Tasmania, is founded.
dz: 塔斯马尼亚州首府霍巴特成立.
de: Hobart, capital of Tasmania, is founded.

t: 在巴黎圣母大教堂,拿破仑·波拿巴亲自加冕为法国皇帝.
te: At Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris, Napoleon Bonaparte crowns himself Emperor of the French.
dz: 在巴黎圣母大教堂,拿破仑·波拿巴亲自加冕为法国皇帝.
de: At Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris, Napoleon Bonaparte crowns himself Emperor of the French.

t: 美国众议院通过弹劾最高法院法官塞缪尔·蔡斯的条款.
te: The United States House of Representatives adopts articles of impeachment against Supreme Court Justice Samuel Chase.
dz: 美国众议院通过弹劾最高法院法官塞缪尔·蔡斯的条款.
de: The United States House of Representatives adopts articles of impeachment against Supreme Court Justice Samuel Chase.
